summary: This clinical trial is testing a drug called Henggliflozin to see how it affects blood sugar changes in people with type 2 diabetes who already take insulin. The study includes 64 participants aged 50 to 70 years. Researchers will compare Henggliflozin against a dummy substance called a placebo. The trial is currently Recruiting and is sponsored by Xinhua Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine.

facts.sponsor: Xinhua Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine
